en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large fortified complex with a tall ornate church tower on the left and a massive round defensive tower on the right, connected by a long multi‑story building. The style is Gothic/medieval with later modifications. Red printed German text at the top identifies the location as Wittenberg on the Elbe, with references to the Lutherkirche and the Schlosskaserne.
